(2) Where in any trial of an offence under sub-section (1), if the fact that the accused person or any other person on his behalf has acquired or is in possession of property, movable or immovable, disproportionate to his known sources of income, is proved, the Court shall presume, unless the accused succeeds to rebut such presumption in the Court, that the accused person is guilty of said offence and a conviction thereof shall not be invalid by reason only that it is based on such presumption." 

 14. Moreover, it transpires from the first information report that there is independent allegation against the accused-petitioner Mrs Salma Shahadat @ Salma Rahman, who allegedly acquired valuable property disproportionate to her known source of income and, as such, she is liable to rebut presumption in the Court as contemplated under section 27(2) of the Anti-Corruption Commission Act, 2004.
